# RSS Feed Article Extraction

## Article 1
**Title:** "Beyond the Stereotype: A Man's Journey to Authentic Connection"

**Publication Date:** Monday, September 15, 2025

**URL:** https://medium.com/@getnetdemil/beyond-the-stereotype-a-mans-journey-to-authentic-connection-28c357bd8912?source=rss-49f360a38657------2

**Description:** An extensive personal exploration examining gender stereotypes, relationship dynamics, and the challenge of being recognized as an individual rather than a representative of one's gender. The work spans nine chapters organized into three parts addressing identity burdens, connection complexity, and breaking through limiting narratives.

---

## Article 2
**Title:** "Seeing is NOT Believing": A Fundamental Reframe for AI Systems"

**Publication Date:** Monday, September 1, 2025

**URL:** https://medium.com/@getnetdemil/seeing-is-not-believing-a-fundamental-reframe-for-ai-systems-886ca5a2139b?source=rss-49f360a38657------2

**Description:** A technical analysis distinguishing between observable, measurable elements of machine learning systems versus the invisible processes requiring belief. The piece examines what can be directly verified in AI architectures versus theoretical mechanisms operating beyond direct observation.

# Getnet Demil Jenberia – Comprehensive Resume Extract

## Contact Information
- **Email**: [email protected]
- **Phone**: +358... (partially obscured)
- **Location**: University of Oulu, Finland
- **Website**: https://getnetdemil.github.io
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/getnetdemil/
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/in/getnetdemil/
- **ORCID**: https://orcid.org/0009-0006-5158-0895
- **Google Scholar**: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=Xz_tNToAAAAJ&hl=en

## Professional Summary
PhD researcher specializing in GeoAI, remote sensing, and AI-driven hydrological modeling, focused on "creating deep learning frameworks to estimate snow hydrology parameters using Earth observation data."

## Education Timeline
- **PhD in AI and Remote Sensing for Hydrology Modeling** – University of Oulu (2024–present), Oulu, Finland
- **Erasmus Mundus Joint MSc in Image Processing & Computer Vision** – University of Bordeaux, Autonomous University of Madrid, Pazmany Peter Catholic University (2022–2024), France/Spain/Hungary
- **MSc in Communication System Engineering** – Bahir Dar University (2020–2022)
- **B.S. in Electrical Engineering** – Bahir Dar University (2013–2018), Bahir Dar, Ethiopia (*Award-Winning Thesis)

## Work Experience Timeline
- **Doctoral Researcher in AI and Remote Sensing** – University of Oulu, Finland (09/2024–Present)
- **Computer Vision Research on Deep Learning** – University of Oulu, Finland (02/2024–08/2024)
- **Technology Officer** – US Embassy, American Spaces in Ethiopia (2021–2022)
- **Junior Electrical Engineer** – Ethiopian Electric Utility, Ethiopia (2019–2022)

## Research Visits & Secondments
- **Doctoral Research Visit** – Institute of Food and Agricultural Sciences, TREC, University of Florida (06/2026–07/2026)
  - Focus: Multi-sensor data fusion (Sentinel-1/2 with drone and ground data)
  - CNN-based analysis of multispectral and thermal drone imagery
  - Field validation methodology exchange
  - Joint publication and grant planning

- **Doctoral Research Secondment** – Research Institute of Sweden (RISE), Gothenburg (01/2026–02/2026)
  - Designed multi-task deep learning architecture for Nordic snow monitoring
  - Three interconnected problems: depth estimation, 7-day forecasting, extreme event detection
  - Trained on 10 years operational data (SMHI + MESAN)

## Research Interests
- AI for hydrological modeling
- Multi-temporal and multi-sensor data fusion
- Snow water equivalent and snow cover estimation
- Foundation models for Earth observation
- Climate-focused computer vision

## Current Research Focus
PhD research designs "deep learning architectures for extracting physically meaningful snow hydrology parameters from multi-sensor Earth observation data," integrating SAR and optical satellite imagery through multi-temporal fusion.

## Skills

**Academic Skills**: Image Processing, Computer Vision, Deep Learning, ML, AI, Remote Sensing, GIS, Google Earth Engine

**Programming & Tools**: Python, C++, MATLAB, PyTorch, JavaScript; Windows, Linux, Debian, Ubuntu

## Languages
- **English**: Proficient (C1)
- **Amharic**: Native Speaker
- **Spanish**: A1
- **Finnish**: A1

## Publications (5+)
1. "Advances in image based estimation of snow variable: A systematic literature review on recent studies" – *Journal of Hydrology* (2025), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jhydrol.2025.132855

2. "Seeing through the clouds: enhanced snow and cloud segmentation in sentinel-2 imagery with mDeepLabV3+" – *Earth Science Informatics* (2025), https://doi.org/10.1007/s12145-025-01950-6

3. "AI-based Approach in Early Warning Systems: Focus on Emergency Communication Ecosystem and Citizen Participation in Nordic Countries" – Book Chapter, arXiv:2506.18926

## Conference Presentations
- "Leveraging Social Media for Real-time Monitoring of Local Climate Impact" – ACM SIGIR, https://doi.org/10.1145/3769733.3769737

- "AI-Enhanced Snow and Cloud Segmentation in Sentinel-2 Imagery Using Dilated DeepLabv3+ with ResNet Backbone" – Nordic Workshop on AI for Climate Change (2025)

## Major Projects & Research
- **Deep Learning Based Snow Hydrology Parameter Estimation from Image Sensors** (2024) – Applied deep learning to estimate snow parameters with complete pipeline from data acquisition to performance evaluation

- **Vision Aided Recognition of Objects to Grasp with a Robot Arm; Object 6D Position Estimation** (2022–2023) – Used DenseFusion for 6D pose estimation for upper-limb disability assistance; custom dataset created with Unity and HTC Vive

- **Advanced Image Processing Method on UAV Images** (2023) – Semantic segmentation on crop fields using U-Net, Attention U-Net, and DeepLabV3+

- **Aerial Image Restoration and Land Type Identification System Using Customized Deconvolution and Texture Analysis** (2022)

## Awards
- **Best African Project of the Year** – African Innovation Week 2019
- **Best Project of the Year** – Bahir Dar University (2018)
- Project: "Design and Implementation of a Smart Microscope for Protozoan Disease Automatic Detection and Diagnosis"

## References
**Mourad Oussalah**, Professor, University of Oulu, Finland, [email protected]
